fnol_text: My name is Ines Gallagher and I live at 545 Oakridge Avenue, Dover, DE 19925. You can reach me on (555) 390-5703 or ines.gallagher@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 5 June 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00050. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Gallagher on (555) 390-5703 to acknowledge the claim. Ines confirmed the loss date as 5 June 2026.
Site visit to 545 Oakridge Avenue. Neighbour Arjun Jovanovic was present and confirmed the timeline.
Ines sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
